pages.text:
The Food Market perfectly com-
bines the elements of excitement 
and comfort. Chef Chad Gauss’s 
“daring culinary approaches to 
comfort food” is what makes The 
Food Market exciting and unlike 
any other place (Barbera). Lori 
Gardner, a Food Market lover, 
states, “I will definitely be back 
soon, because in my opinion the 
food is simply…Divine.” The great 
service, charming environment, 
and delightful dishes make The 
Food Market a place you will want 
to return to again and again.  
 
My family and I went to The Food Market for 
brunch. After we were seated, our waiter 
started us off with a basket filled with dough-
nuts that tasted like heaven with each bite. 
Even Julia, Loyola’18, agrees, “The food itself 
was amazing, but my favorite part was the 
doughnuts. They bring them at the start of 
your meal and just keep them coming” 
(McRae). When it came time to order, I got 
the French toast, my sister ordered the egg 
white omelette, and my dad ordered the ar-
my breakfast. My mom, however, was having 
trouble deciding what to order and asked our 
waiter what he suggested. Our waiter re-
sponded, without hesitation, that the Smokey 
Bowl was his favorite dish. The Smokey Bowl 
consists of bacon, gouda cream, potato grat-
in, dippy eggs, English muffin, hollandaise, 
and chipotle flakes. The mouth-watering in-
gredients of the Smokey Bowl persuaded my 
mom to get it. Once our food came, we all

Chad Gauss, The Food Market’s chef, de-
scribes the restaurant as “blue collar food 
with white collar execution” (Gorelick). The 
Baltimore Sun simply explains, “that means a 
fundamentally accessible menu but with 
enough playful moments to hold a diner’s 
interest” (Gorelick). The Food Market’s play-
ful menu is certainly enough to keep the 
restaurant busy.  Amy Langrehr, an avid at-
tender of The Food Market, describes the 
restaurant as “good food, with interesting 
ingredients, presented creatively and at the 
same time, not fancy schmancy.”

and although they were all deli-
cious, the Smokey Bowl was by far 
the best. The Smokey Bowl’s amaz-
ing blend of ingredients was like 
nothing I have ever had before in 
my life. The dish was so good that 
my sister and I devoured it all, leav-
ing nothing behind but a clean 
bowl. We left The Food Market sat-
isfied and smiling.
